name: Eggless Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk buttermilk with 25 g melted butter, then fold into the dry mix just until no dry flour remains; small lumps are fine. Rest 5 minutes.
Warm a nonstick pan over medium-low heat and brush with some remaining butter. Pour eight small pancakes in batches.
Cook each 2–3 minutes until bubbles appear and the edges set; flip and cook 1–2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Stack warm pancakes and serve with maple syrup and berries.
tips: Do not overmix; it makes the pancakes tough.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
